prompt: Which statements about Redis Cluster are correct?
explanation: The cluster splits the keyspace into 16384 slots; multi-key commands work only when every key hashes to the same slot; hash tags such as {user:42}.profile force co-location by hashing only the text inside the braces; and replication is asynchronous, so a master may acknowledge writes that have not reached its replicas yet.

options.text: The keyspace is divided into 16384 hash slots distributed across master nodes
Multi-key commands work only when all involved keys hash to the same slot
Replication to replicas is synchronous, so acknowledged writes are always safe on a replica
A hash tag like the braces around user:42 makes different keys share one slot
